segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily or overly oily say the wash keeps shine under control all day and, combined with sensitivity, still calms redness and inflammation without irritation.
segments.dry: The reviewers with dry skin say the wash clears blemishes without the dryness they get from other acne cleansers, though they still apply moisturizer afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin get mixed results on the face — one saw no change in her mild facial acne while another had no issues at all — though one found it slightly drying.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who call it extremely sensitive, report clear skin and no irritation, but several warn the wash can leave a burning, itchy feeling if it isn't followed by a thorough moisturizer, especially when paired with acids or retinol.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who calls her skin normal says the 10% strength did not dry her out or cause irritation, though she cautions against combining it with a salicylic acid treatment if your skin is sensitive.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or specific blemishes disappearing, including cystic, hormonal, and body acne, usually within one to several weeks; a minority say it did nothing for their acne, made it noticeably worse, or only worked on the body and not the face.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several who call their own skin dry, say the wash does not dry out their skin and can even feel hydrating once moisturizer is applied after; a smaller group reports tightness, itchiness, scaliness, or lasting dryness, particularly when using it alongside acids or retinol or at the 10% strength.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness mostly report a reduction in redness, swelling, or inflammation, with one exception who noted minor temporary redness alongside dryness from the 10% benzoyl peroxide strength.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: some reviewers say the wash faded old acne marks or discoloration on the body, while one saw no difference in her dark spots after a week of use.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewers who mention oiliness say the wash keeps their skin matte and less oily throughout the day, with no reports of it increasing oiliness.

Can bleach clothing, towels, or hair
Large bottle lasts a long time

extraits.titre: BEWARE: DO NOT USE THIS PRODUCT
extraits.texte: My experience with this product was absolutely horrible!!! I am currently struggling with the long term effects of using this. I bought this product to help with acne and followed the directions exactly how it was stated to help get rid of my acne and it made it 100 times worse. I should have stopped using it right away but kept using because I wanted to get past the "purging" stage. Please use my experience and do not use this product. Your skin will be better off without this product. I have now spent hundreds of dollars to get rid of the damages that were left by this product and I still don't see a light at the end of the tunnel. What this product has done to my face and my confidence is sad.

I decided to try this after using the 4% with no issues, and all I was left with was a consistent itchy pain that's still lasting more than 24hours. It doesn't matter how much moisturizer you put on. You could use the whole bottle and the dryness and itch would still be there. It might just be too strong for me but if you were considering the stronger basic medicated face wash, stick with the 4%. I would never use this one again. The cream does not foam or smell and feels like I'm wiping toothpaste on my face. They really need to get the foaming together on both.

Highly recommend this product! I do have slightly sensitive skin, but this clears uo my acne. I only use this specific product once or twice a week along with my other daily use cerave product. If you have sensitive skin be sure to moisturize very well after use. Leaves a burning and itchy sensation of you don't rehydrate your skin!

I received CeraVe Acne Foamong Cream Wash as a sample from BzzAgent. Its a good moisturing cleanser with a thick consistency. It does clean the skin very well and might help with discoloration of the skin. I have combination skin and very mild acne on my face but it didnt help me with the acne. Its still the same after several days of wash. I also used it on some parts of my body with some discolorations and yes it does brighten the skin. Didnt work for my face acne but might work for you. Give it a try as it doesn't cause any dryness or irritation.

The Cerave Acne Foaming Cream Wash is a great product if you're looking for a product that does not dry out your skin. Personally. I find alot of acne cleanser are too drying on my dry skin. Yes, dry skin can be acne prone too! This worked great for me and cleared up some blemishes pretty quickly. I would definitely recommend this product to friends and family.

I have been loving and using this cleanser for the last 3 years and I love using it to clear any acne or random pimples I might get on my face!! I have extremely sensitive and oily skin, and this has been the only cleanser that I have loved using. I also love that this cleanser reduces redness and inflammation. If you are looking for a great cleanser for acne THIS is the one, but of course not all products will work for every ones skin type 😁

I finally had it with my acne as I recently started breaking out randomly. This helps SO MUCH. It's not magic obviously, but after about a month, my acne decreased by like 75%. I use it consistently with a salicylic acid spot treatment and my acne is practically gone. I DO NOT recommend doing that if you have sensitive skin. Mine is very average "normal" The 10% doesnt dry me out or cause irritation. The only annoying thing is if you don't get it 100% off after, you can bleach your clothing. Make sure you rinse really well all over and use a towel you don't care about just in case. Once I rinsed more thoroughly, I didnt have that issue.
